children: will operate high-power charging stations at three new electric truck depots being developed by Forum Mobility in California, expanding infrastructure for heavy-duty vehicles as the automaker prepares to widen the reach of its Semi truck.
The three sites, FM Francis in Ontario, and FM Adeline and FM Coliseum in Oakland, will use Tesla's
Megawatt Charging System technology alongside CCS charging ports. Forum said the facilities will have pull-through lanes intended to allow trucks to charge without disrupting.
Across the new depots, Forum is adding 30 megawatts of charging capacity. At its Santa Fe facility in Rancho Dominguez, fleet operators have committed to more than 330 Tesla
Semi trucks, while the charging site will also be open to other commercial trucking customers.
Forum has also installed two MCS Megachargers at FM Harbor, its Port of Long Beach depot, which began operating in December 2024.
The infrastructure rollout comes as Tesla
prepares to expand availability of the Semi beyond North America, with a European launch planned for next year.

title: Tesla partners with Forum Mobility on California truck charging sites
